verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a hardware component with no data-application interface of its own, so getting AI-generated insights from a user's data inside the product is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only general marketing that Ryzen is a 'gateway to AI experiences' (i.e., it runs AI workloads) and Ryzen Master's non-AI monitoring and tuning. Nothing shows the product itself generating AI insights or suggestions from user data, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
